originality.rationale: Relevant published full statements establish general radial density extremal context, definitions and non-sharp arbitrary-q estimates, and the sharp q=4/p=2 endpoint. They do not imply the combined strict local stability for every p<2 plus an explicit certified global loss already at p=7/4. Historical priority remains provisional; no database search alone is interpreted as proof.
residual_risks: A different classical formulation of finite-vertex dual volume or weighted polygon moment may already imply the intermediate-power coexistence.
The p=2 endpoint result makes nearby nonregular superiority plausible by continuity, so priority rests on the all-p<2 Hessian theorem and the quantitatively earlier explicit p=7/4 witness together.

value.rationale: The one-parameter radial power family interpolates the classical area objective and known fourth dual moment. Strict local equilateral stability for every exponent below the endpoint but simultaneous global inferiority at a rational interior exponent is a structural local/global symmetry-breaking phenomenon in natural inscribed-polygon optimization. This motivated counterexample remains meaningful without a complete phase diagram.
